findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/IsManifold/InteriorBoundary.lean:86,111 — `[ChartedSpace H M]` ... `protected def boundary : Set M := { x : M | I.IsBoundaryPoint x }`, with no `IsManifold`. findings.fix: Drop `[IsManifold closedUpperHalfPlaneModel 1 M]` from `boundaryInl` and `boundaryInl_apply`. Keep it only on lemmas that use `mem_boundary_euclideanHalfSpace_iff_notMem_borderedInterior` or the doubled-chart formulas.
findings.issue: `def boundaryInl [IsManifold closedUpperHalfPlaneModel 1 M] (y : (𝓡∂ (1 + 1)).boundary M) := DoubleAlong.inl _ (y : M)` and `boundaryInl_apply` (proved by `rfl`) never use the `IsManifold` assumption. The boundary type only needs the charted-space structure, which the local `euclideanHalfSpaceChartedSpace` instance provides.

findings.evidence: Both lemmas contain the same `have hxim : (extChartAt closedUpperHalfPlaneModel x x).im = 0 := by simpa ... using (im_eq_zero_iff_notMem_borderedInterior ...).2 hx` block, followed by `mem_strictInwardTangentCone_iff` and `mem_strictInwardCone_closedUpperHalfPlaneModel_iff`.
findings.fix: Prove it as `(mem_strictInwardTangentCone_iff_im_mfderiv_inl_pos x hx v).trans` after rewriting with `mfderiv_inr_apply`, `mfderiv_inl_apply` and `Complex.conj_im`, then finish with `neg_lt_zero`.
findings.issue: `mem_strictInwardTangentCone_iff_im_mfderiv_inr_neg` repeats the first-sheet argument: the same `hxim` computation via `im_eq_zero_iff_notMem_borderedInterior` and the same use of `mem_strictInwardCone_closedUpperHalfPlaneModel_iff`. It is a corollary of the first-sheet lemma, because the second-sheet derivative is the conjugate of the first-sheet one.

summary: The full-sheet and native-boundary results are at the right level, but `boundaryInl` and `boundaryInl_apply` carry an unused manifold assumption, and the second-sheet inward-sign lemma repeats the first-sheet proof instead of deriving from it.
